name: Josh Anderson
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years experience in backend development, reliable event tracking, and scalable infrastructure for distributed systems. Adept at designing and maintaining robust, performant, and multi-region applications for billing, entitlements, data collection, data migration, real-time reporting, and comprehensive search technologies. Proven ability to lead projects from initial concept and discovery through to production, collaborating with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders, to achieve substantial business growth.

experience.blurb: GPS navigation and mapping application tools (Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, Fish) for millions of outdoor adventurers.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer

highlights.text: Built Stripe Checkout purchasing APIs for web express pay, enabling non-app-store payment option for iOS and Android, providing customers more purchasing autonomy, and directly increasing the profit margin potential of all onX subscriptions.

Architected and delivered a refactored system of record for purchases, payment profiles, memberships, entitlements, and subscription lifecycle events - leveraging Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, Oban Pro, PostgreSQL, SpiceDB, and GCP PubSub.

Led the backfill of legacy purchase data across separate payment gateways (Apple, Google, Stripe, internal), into a modernized and extensible data schema, and successfully achieved a rigorous five-nines historical reconciliation accuracy goal (99.999%).

The core event-driven job-processing framework and pushed fundamental system design architecture decisions: dynamic concurrency control, durable workflow composition, multi-cluster distributed processing, and database-backed coordination.

highlights: Implemented Stripe Payment Intent logic: endpoints, webhook handlers, and 12+ orchestrated workflows covering full subscription lifecycle.
Drove end-to-end observability: custom OpenTelemetry tracing of Oban Pro workflows, Prometheus + Grafana dashboards, and Sentry alerting.
Integrated downstream services through GCP PubSub pipelines and CDC feeds, retaining full integrity of analytics, user traits, and notifications.
Enabled entitlement dissemination of multi-state user role claims through ISO 3166 Alpha-2 geodata validation for IAM required feature access.
Provisioned backend infrastructure with Atlantis Terraform PR CI/CD, multi-region CockroachDB scaling, and GCP secrets management config.
Advocated early adoption of AI-assisted engineering initiatives and facilitated Claude, Codex, and Copilot developer workflow integrations.

experience.blurb: Online hotel room booker and software company creating trip planning and experience sharing tools for travelers.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Team Lead
highlights: Achieved 99.99% uptime across all critical core systems and services responsible for processing thousands of daily hotel room bookings.
Cut P95 performance average for hotel rate search response times from ~10s to ~3s, saving a combined ~800+ hours of daily search time.
Led team of junior developers in building an in-house Content Management System for facilitating direct real-time hotel content overrides.
Contributed to rebuild of core hotel bookings engine, modernizing an antiquated Ruby on Rails monolith to a robust Elixir umbrella application.
Implemented a resilient data collection system for high-accuracy metrics and reporting using AWS Kinesis, AWS Lambda, and Snowflake.
Migrated internal image service to Cloudflare Images CDN, significantly improving delivery speeds to clients for over 3.2 million hotel images.
Added user image uploads moderation, classification, and sentiment analysis tagging through AWS Rekognition and OpenAI GPT Assistants.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and patented "Assembler", the multi-provider mapping aggregation logic, to standardize and normalize over 79,000+ hotel records.
Designed and maintained scalable hotel content import and delivery pipelines using Elixir, Golang, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and AWS Kinesis.
Enhanced system observability and monitoring by integrating industry leading telemetry tools, such as DataDog, Honeybadger, and Splunk.
Improved provider hotel content import and update frequency from monthly/weekly release cycles to daily automated Oban cron jobs.

Optimized database queries, and caching mechanisms implemented in Redis, contributing to a 25% reduction in overall AWS tech spend.

Added AWS CloudFront CDN integration to in-house image service, improving hosting, resizing, and delivery performance for all hotel images.
